canonical_term: TIF Assessor Base and Excess Administration
aliases: base value and excess value workflow
summary: County assessor workflow for receiving TIF notices, determining or verifying redevelopment project valuation, maintaining base/excess values, certifying valuation data for levy/reporting purposes, and coordinating with county treasurer, city/CRA, and DOR PAD.
plain_language: Once a project uses TIF, the assessor has a valuation and reporting lane separate from the ordinary taxpayer-facing value conversation.

steps.action: file Notice to Divide Tax with county assessor by July 1 of effective calendar year
verify or determine redevelopment project valuation/base value and complete assessor section of notice
retain original and distribute copies to city/CRA, county treasurer, and DOR PAD
annually certify base and excess values to authority and county treasurer; include base-only value for levy setting and required abstract/school/CTL reporting
distribute base taxes to political subdivisions and excess taxes to special fund under statutory/form directions
notify assessor, treasurer, and Property Tax Administrator when indebtedness is paid so taxes return to ordinary distribution

relationships.note: TIF base/excess affects levy certification and tax distribution.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Notice to Divide Tax for Community Redevelopment Project TIF Project, Rev. 3-2025.
Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 18.
